chapterInfo.content:
15
Yesu ne nokorɛ bobe no
1 Mene nokorɛ bobe no, na m’Agya ne okuafoɔ no. 2Me ho ban biara a ɛnso aba no, ɔyi; na ebiara a ɛso aba no, ɔyiyi ho, na aso aba bebree. 3Asɛm a maka makyerɛ mo no nti, mo ho anya afi. 4Montena me mu, na me nso mentena mo mu: Sɛdeɛ ban ntumi mfiri ɔno ara mu nso aba gye sɛ ɛtena bobe no mu no, saa ara nso na montumi, gye sɛ motena me mu. 5#2 Ko 3.5 Mene bobe no, mone mman no. Deɛ ɔtena me mu na me nso metena ne mu no, ɔno ara na ɔso aba pii; na mokwati me a, montumi nyɛ hwee. 6Sɛ obi antena me mu a, wɔto no twene sɛ ban, na ɛwu; na wɔboaboa ano de kɔgu gya mu, na ɛhye.
7 # Mar 11.24 Sɛ motena me mu, na me nsɛm tena mo mu a, mobɛsrɛ biribiara a mopɛ, na ɛbɛyɛ hɔ ama mo. 8Yei mu na wɔahyɛ m’Agya animuonyam, sɛ moso aba pii; ɛno na mobɛyɛ m’asuafoɔ.
9 Sɛdeɛ Agya no adɔ me no, na me nso madɔ mo; montena me dɔ mu! 10#Yoh 14.15 Sɛ modi m’ahyɛdeɛ so a, mobɛtena me dɔ mu, sɛdeɛ madi m’Agya ahyɛdeɛ soɔ na mete ne dɔ mu no.
11 # Yoh 17.13 Maka yeinom nyinaa makyerɛ mo, na m’anigyeɛ atena mo mu, na mo anigyeɛ awie pɛyɛ. 12#Yoh 13.34 Yei ne m’ahyɛdeɛ, sɛ monnodɔ mo ho sɛdeɛ medɔɔ mo no. 13#Yoh 10.11; 1 Yoh 3.16 Obi nni dɔ kɛseɛ a ɛsene yei, sɛ obi de ne nkwa bɛto hɔ ama ne nnamfo. 14#Yoh 8.31 Sɛ moyɛ deɛ mehyɛ mo a, na moyɛ me nnamfo. 15Memfrɛ mo nkoa bio, ɛfiri sɛ akoa nnim deɛ ne wura reyɛ; na mafrɛ mo nnamfo, ɛfiri sɛ nnoɔma a mate no m’Agya nkyɛn nyinaa maka makyerɛ mo. 16Ɛnyɛ mo na moayi me, na me na mayi mo, na mede mo masi hɔ sɛ monkɔ, na monkɔso aba, na mo aba no ntena hɔ, na biribiara a mobɛsrɛ Agya no me din mu no, ɔde ama mo. 17Yei na mehyɛ mo, sɛ monnodɔ mo ho.
Wiase tane ne ɔtaa
18 # Yoh 7.7 Sɛ wiase tane mo a, monhunu sɛ watane me kane ansa na ɛretane mo. 19#1 Yoh 4.5; Yoh 17.14 Sɛ mofiri wiase a, anka wiase bɛdɔ ɔno ara ne deɛ; na sɛ momfiri wiase na mayi mo afiri wiase yi, yei nti na wiase tane mo. 20#Yoh 13.16 Monkae asɛm a meka mekyerɛɛ mo sɛ: Akoa nsene ne wura. Sɛ wɔataa me a, wɔbɛtaa mo nso; sɛ wɔadi m’asɛm so a, wɔbɛdi mo deɛ so bi. 21#Yoh 16.3 Na yeinom nyinaa, me din nti na wɔde bɛyɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnim deɛ ɔsomaa me no.
22 Sɛ mamma mammɛka mankyerɛ wɔn a, anka wɔnni bɔne; na afei deɛ, wɔnni wɔn bɔne ho anoyie. 23#Yoh 5.23 Deɛ ɔtane me no tane m’Agya no nso. 24#Yoh 14.11 Sɛ manyɛ nnwuma a obiara nyɛɛ da wɔ wɔn mu a, anka wɔnni bɔne; na afei deɛ, wɔahunu, nanso wɔatane me ne m’Agya. 25#Dwom 69.4 Na ɛyɛɛ hɔ, na asɛm a wɔatwerɛ no wɔn mmara mu no aba mu sɛ: Wɔtane me kwa.
26 # Yoh 14.26; Luk 24.49 Na Okyigyinafoɔ a mɛsoma no mabrɛ mo afiri Agya no nkyɛn, nokorɛ Honhom a ɔfiri Agya no nkyɛn reba no, sɛ ɔnya ba a, ɔno na ɔbɛdi me ho adanseɛ; 27#Aso 1.8; 5.32 na mo nso mobɛdi adanseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ moka me ho firi mfitiaseɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Mene nokorɛ bobe no, na m’Agya ne okuafoɔ no. Me ho ban biara a ɛnso aba no, ɔyi; na ebiara a ɛso aba no, ɔyiyi ho, na aso aba bebree. Asɛm a maka makyerɛ mo no nti, mo ho anya afi. Montena me mu, na me nso mentena mo mu: Sɛdeɛ ban ntumi mfiri ɔno ara mu nso aba gye sɛ ɛtena bobe no mu no, saa ara nso na montumi, gye sɛ motena me mu. Mene bobe no, mone mman no. Deɛ ɔtena me mu na me nso metena ne mu no, ɔno ara na ɔso aba pii; na mokwati me a, montumi nyɛ hwee. Sɛ obi antena me mu a, wɔto no twene sɛ ban, na ɛwu; na wɔboaboa ano de kɔgu gya mu, na ɛhye.
Sɛ motena me mu, na me nsɛm tena mo mu a, mobɛsrɛ biribiara a mopɛ, na ɛbɛyɛ hɔ ama mo. Yei mu na wɔahyɛ m’Agya animuonyam, sɛ moso aba pii; ɛno na mobɛyɛ m’asuafoɔ.
Sɛdeɛ Agya no adɔ me no, na me nso madɔ mo; montena me dɔ mu! Sɛ modi m’ahyɛdeɛ so a, mobɛtena me dɔ mu, sɛdeɛ madi m’Agya ahyɛdeɛ soɔ na mete ne dɔ mu no.
Maka yeinom nyinaa makyerɛ mo, na m’anigyeɛ atena mo mu, na mo anigyeɛ awie pɛyɛ. Yei ne m’ahyɛdeɛ, sɛ monnodɔ mo ho sɛdeɛ medɔɔ mo no. Obi nni dɔ kɛseɛ a ɛsene yei, sɛ obi de ne nkwa bɛto hɔ ama ne nnamfo. Sɛ moyɛ deɛ mehyɛ mo a, na moyɛ me nnamfo. Memfrɛ mo nkoa bio, ɛfiri sɛ akoa nnim deɛ ne wura reyɛ; na mafrɛ mo nnamfo, ɛfiri sɛ nnoɔma a mate no m’Agya nkyɛn nyinaa maka makyerɛ mo. Ɛnyɛ mo na moayi me, na me na mayi mo, na mede mo masi hɔ sɛ monkɔ, na monkɔso aba, na mo aba no ntena hɔ, na biribiara a mobɛsrɛ Agya no me din mu no, ɔde ama mo. Yei na mehyɛ mo, sɛ monnodɔ mo ho.

Sɛ wiase tane mo a, monhunu sɛ watane me kane ansa na ɛretane mo. Sɛ mofiri wiase a, anka wiase bɛdɔ ɔno ara ne deɛ; na sɛ momfiri wiase na mayi mo afiri wiase yi, yei nti na wiase tane mo. Monkae asɛm a meka mekyerɛɛ mo sɛ: Akoa nsene ne wura. Sɛ wɔataa me a, wɔbɛtaa mo nso; sɛ wɔadi m’asɛm so a, wɔbɛdi mo deɛ so bi. Na yeinom nyinaa, me din nti na wɔde bɛyɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnim deɛ ɔsomaa me no.
Sɛ mamma mammɛka mankyerɛ wɔn a, anka wɔnni bɔne; na afei deɛ, wɔnni wɔn bɔne ho anoyie. Deɛ ɔtane me no tane m’Agya no nso. Sɛ manyɛ nnwuma a obiara nyɛɛ da wɔ wɔn mu a, anka wɔnni bɔne; na afei deɛ, wɔahunu, nanso wɔatane me ne m’Agya. Na ɛyɛɛ hɔ, na asɛm a wɔatwerɛ no wɔn mmara mu no aba mu sɛ: Wɔtane me kwa.
Na Okyigyinafoɔ a mɛsoma no mabrɛ mo afiri Agya no nkyɛn, nokorɛ Honhom a ɔfiri Agya no nkyɛn reba no, sɛ ɔnya ba a, ɔno na ɔbɛdi me ho adanseɛ; na mo nso mobɛdi adanseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ moka me ho firi mfitiaseɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
